results.title: ixigo Q2 profit at Rs 63 cr on robust show in hotel booking biz
results.description: Ixigo reported a remarkable turnaround with a consolidated net profit of Rs 63.42 crore for the September quarter, bouncing back from a net loss of Rs 3.46 crore from last year. The surge in hotel bookings played a key role in this financial upswing, leading to operational revenue of Rs 320.96 crore.

results.title: Sydney coming alive in October with Parramatta Lanes, the city’s biggest street festival
results.description: One of the most buzzing metropolises in world, Sydney, is hosting its biggest street festival, Parramatta Lanes, from October 21 to 24.
